assignment.title: Tavern Talk - A Cozy Visual Novel

notes_text: A dialogue-driven, cozy fantasy visual novel about running a tavern, serving magical drinks, gathering rumors and following adventurers' stories in a Dungeons & Dragons-inspired world. Developer Gentle Troll Entertainment; Steam release 20 June 2024. The frozen full title is exact.

source_log.observation: Official Steam listing uses the full frozen title, names drinks, rumors, D&D-inspired setting and release.
